seam: logos TextTheory decision vector v1 (UNFROZEN v1)
note: Language-AGNOSTIC tri-core THEORY-DECISION agreement vectors for the byte-string TextTheory (logos-core/text-theory@1.0.0). Each entry is a ground text atom (predicate + args) together with the PINNED Theory.decide outcome. The decision oracle is the search-side builtins (builtin_contains/starts_with/ends_with in core/rs/src/builtins.rs); contract/{rs,go,ts} TextTheory.decide MUST reproduce every outcome byte-for-byte (the §7 dual-conformance law). Operands are RAW Atom bytes, NOT the utf8-text embedding: {"atom": "<utf8>"} = a bare Atom of those UTF-8 bytes (the oracle's path); {"text": "<s>"} = the ontos-data utf8-text embedding (a Tuple, used to pin the not-an-atom -> text_does_not_hold class); {"tuple": [..]} = a raw compound Tuple. Empty needle/prefix/suffix HOLD. Outcome is "holds" or {"fails": "<code>"} where the code is one of the pinned host-band sub-codes text_does_not_hold | text_bad_arity | text_unknown_predicate. owns: contains, starts_with, ends_with.

decisions.name: contains_hit
decisions.note: 'world' is a contiguous subslice of 'hello world'

decisions.name: contains_miss
decisions.note: 'moon' is absent from 'hello world'

decisions.name: contains_empty_needle
decisions.note: the empty needle is contained in everything (needle.is_empty -> true)

decisions.name: contains_empty_haystack_empty_needle
decisions.note: empty contained in empty

decisions.name: contains_needle_longer
decisions.note: needle longer than haystack -> not contained

decisions.name: contains_full_equal
decisions.note: a slice contains itself

decisions.name: contains_multibyte_byte_level
decisions.note: matching is byte-level over the UTF-8 encoding, not codepoint-level

decisions.name: contains_non_atom_haystack_compound
decisions.note: a compound first arg is not a bare Atom -> the byte test cannot run

decisions.name: contains_text_embedding_arg_fails
decisions.note: the utf8-text embedding is a Tuple, not a bare Atom -> not the oracle's raw-bytes path

decisions.name: contains_arity1_bad_arity
decisions.note: contains/1 is not a binary relation

decisions.name: contains_arity3_bad_arity
decisions.note: contains/3 is not a binary relation
